assumptions: Scanned vanilla ideology definitions must match the definitions loaded by the game.
has_government checks the current ruling ideology group in COUNTRY scope; popularity and leader subtype do not activate these contributions.
Only the group's modifiers block and its explicit hidden_modifier presentation wrapper are included.
Faction, member, foreign, targeted and arbitrary nested modifiers are not interpreted as current-country ideology contributions.
Values retain native raw units; e.g. civilian_intel_to_others = 15 is not changed to 0.15.
Native names identify the ideology group that owns the modifier, not a party name or an inferred leader subtype.
Rules and AI settings are not numeric modifier contributions; zero values and unresolved residuals are omitted.

evidence.claim: has_government tests the current country's ruling ideology group.
set_politics sets ruling_party to a new ideology group in country scope.
Fascist national modifiers contain visible values and a hidden_modifier join_faction_tension contribution.

engine_probes.note: Switching ideology also replaces the head of government; this key has no vanilla start leader contribution in the intended GER probe.

engine_probes.purpose: Verify hidden_modifier retains national contribution while the source follows current ruling ideology.
Verify native raw intelligence values and matching source formatting, without dividing the contribution by 100.
